scope: U.S. product identity with issuer-wide Financial Relief Program evidence. Product/account eligibility still requires enrollment review; do not apply this to partner-issued Amex-network cards.

contact.instructions: Use the current call or chat route on the relief page; account review requires authentication.

assessment.explanation: A defined issuer-wide program is published; this is not an individual approval.

assistance_types.text: Potential payment, interest, and fee relief.

eligibility.text: American Express evaluates delinquency, prior participation, and balance.

apr.text: Reduced rate, subject to an existing lower-rate exception.

fees.text: Late and annual membership fees waived while enrolled, if applicable.

account_use.text: Short plan: restricted spending may remain available. Long plan: purchases blocked; restoration requires completion and an uncancelled account.

credit_reporting.text: Current accounts stay current with timely plan payments; delinquent accounts may remain past due. Long-plan participation is disclosed to bureaus; limit reductions and noncompliance can harm credit.

duration.text: Short plan: 12 months. Long plan: 48 months.

termination.text: Consecutive missed payments can end participation and lead to cancellation; ordinary terms resume after exit.

sources.note: Page 1 identifies the product and issuer. Public prospective agreement; existing customers need their account-specific agreement.
Public rendered program terms inspected; text-only retrieval omitted the program body. No enrollment attempted.

search.scope: Reviewed current relief page and the product agreement linked by the issuer's public agreement directory.
search.limitations: Issuer-level terms do not establish this account's offer. No private account or chat was accessed.

refresh_triggers: Before relying on a record or publishing derivatives
